descriptor.scope: North Rhine-Westphalia ALKIS cadastral-reference map; bounded Essen, Cologne, Dortmund, Düsseldorf and Bonn globe entries enabled. Native flstkennz identity is serialized as GeoJSON feature.id; objid and aktualit remain version metadata. Wider municipal completeness and legal survey accuracy remain unverified.
descriptor.attribution: Bezirksregierung Köln / Geobasis NRW, ALKIS simplified schema. Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.

cityScopes.dusseldorf: 162 valid, distinct NRW ALKIS cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Düsseldorf WUP locator. Complete offset paging, forced three-row pages, all 162 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32632 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The existing North Rhine-Westphalia provider is reused. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
cityScopes.bonn: 79 valid distinct NRW ALKIS cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Bonn WUP settlement locator. The existing shared North Rhine-Westphalia OGC API provider is reused. Complete offset paging, forced three-row pages, all 79 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 25 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32632 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Wider municipal completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.
